title: The Sangat Seeks a Written Assurance for the Panth

blocks.text: The sangat receives the Granth's answer as a victorious and consoling command. Drums of joy are imagined, and the congregation turns from relief to responsibility by asking how the Khalsa is to endure and expand in the world.

The damaged lines are best read as a collective prayer for the future of the community. The Singhs ask for a written assurance for the Panth so that those who try to diminish it will fail while the Guru's design remains protected.
The page closes in the tone of ardās rather than argument. It presents the Panth as something sustained not by worldly cunning but by the Guru's foreknowledge, shelter, and explicit promise.
